channel.title: Hands-on AI Cookbook Changelog
channel.description: Latest updates from the Hands-on AI Cookbook — new content, plugins, and platform guides.

item.title: Business-First AI Framework: 7-Step Restructure
item.author: James Gray
item.description: The Business-First AI Framework expands from 3 steps to 7 — with new Test and Improve steps, renamed skills, evaluation criteria, and a skills-only approach replacing portable prompts.

item.title: Outcome-Driven Path and Process Optimization in Deconstruct
item.author: James Gray
item.description: Deconstruct skill adds outcome-driven path for agent systems and optimize-for-AI step for step-decomposed workflows

item.title: CLI Building Block and Smarter Construct
item.author: James Gray
item.description: CLI joins as the 11th agentic building block, and the Construct step now discovers creation tools automatically.

item.title: Data Readiness, 11 Building Blocks, and a Redesigned Build Phase
item.author: James Gray
item.description: Data readiness probing, 11 building blocks, Design Prompt, and the Build phase split into three focused skills.

item.title: Stronger product specs, restructured coding page, and organizational workflows
item.author: James Gray
item.description: Upgraded Vision Brief and Feature PRD skills with deeper PM rigor, restructured Agentic Coding page, and added organizational workflow lens

item.title: Portable Deconstruct Prompt and Markdown-First Registry Skills
item.author: James Gray
item.description: Portable Deconstruct prompt for any AI chat tool and AI Registry skills updated to save markdown files instead of Notion page bodies

item.title: Portable Analyze Prompt and Cross-Platform Install Clarity
item.author: James Gray
item.description: Portable Analyze prompt for non-skill users and cross-platform skill install consistency across framework pages

item.title: Build Phase: Autonomy Levels and Orchestration Mechanisms
item.author: James Gray
item.description: The Build phase now uses a two-step decision model — autonomy assessment plus orchestration mechanism — replacing the old execution pattern spectrum.

item.title: AI Workflow Design Matrix, Building Block Comparison, and Framework Terminology Update
item.author: James Gray
item.description: New AI Workflow Design Matrix defines six workflow archetypes, Building Block Comparison Matrix helps choose the right block, and framework terminology is streamlined site-wide.

item.title: Platform Getting Started Pages, Memory Building Block, and More
item.author: James Gray
item.description: Every platform now has a Getting Started checklist, Memory joins as the 10th building block, and Product & Engineering gets an Evaluation page.

item.title: Plugin Marketplace Moved to Dedicated Repo
item.author: James Gray
item.description: The plugin marketplace moved to a dedicated lightweight repo for faster installs in Cowork and other tools.

item.title: Orchestration patterns, new building blocks, and framework refinements
item.author: James Gray
item.description: Agent orchestration patterns, expanded building blocks, agent programming frameworks, and framework refinements.

item.title: Step 3 Redesigned: Skills Drive the Build
item.author: James Gray
item.description: Step 3 — Build Workflows redesigned around skill-driven orchestration with a new Construct page, Launch Guide, and cross-platform skills standard.

item.title: Build Workflows v3.1, Expanded Agents Matrix, and Streamlined Architecture Decisions
item.author: James Gray
item.description: Building Workflows v3.1 adds plan mode gate, spec approval, and reference specs. Agents matrix expanded with SDK and browser agents. Architecture decisions streamlined.

item.title: Product & Engineering section, ADRs, and platform agent examples
item.author: James Gray
item.description: New Product & Engineering section, Architecture Decision Records page, platform-specific agent examples, and fixed agentic-coding slash commands.

item.title: New Plugin: Agentic Coding
item.author: James Gray
item.description: New plugin for AI-assisted coding workflows — define requirements with structured PRDs before you build.

item.title: New Example: Content Calendar Planning
item.author: James Gray
item.description: See what the Business-First AI Framework actually produces — a complete worked example with all three deliverables for a real content planning workflow.

item.title: Agentic Coding Plugin: Stronger PRDs and Vision Briefs
item.author: James Gray
item.description: Agentic Coding plugin update: PRD skill gets paired AC/user stories and scope sections; Vision Brief skill adds strategic depth with 10 questions and inline examples.

item.title: Slash Commands for All Plugin Skills
item.author: James Gray
item.description: All 10 plugin skills now have slash commands — invoke any skill directly instead of relying on auto-triggering.

item.title: Introducing the Changelog and MCP Server
item.author: James Gray
item.description: New Changelog with RSS feed, plus a dedicated MCP server so AI assistants can search the cookbook directly.
